nanananda_verbatim:
And this point, too, is hard to see, namely the stilling
   of all preparations, the relinquishment of all assets, the destruction
   of craving, detachment, cessation, extinction.
plain_english_below: And this point, too, is hard to see, namely everything the mind makes comes to a stop, the letting go of everything carried, the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.
tts_line: And this point, too, is hard to see, namely, everything the mind makes comes to a stop, the letting go of everything carried, the wanting ends, nothing pulls you any more, stopping, going out, like a flame with no fuel.

nanananda_verbatim: Where the winding ends and the rewinding begins is a matter beyond our comprehension. But one thing is clear all these comes to cease when craving and grasping are abandoned.
plain_english_below: Where the winding ends and the rewinding begins is a matter beyond our comprehension. But one thing is clear all these comes to cease when craving and holding on are abandoned.
tts_line: Where the winding ends and the rewinding begins is a matter beyond our comprehension. But one thing is clear all these comes to cease when craving and holding on are abandoned.

nanananda_verbatim:
sorrows, grieves, and laments;
he weeps and beats his breast and becomes distraught. This is called an
uninstructed worldling who has not risen up in the bottomless abyss, one
who has not gained a foothold.

nanananda_verbatim:
The world arises in the six sense-bases. It is at the same time the
arising of suffering... The law of dependent arising is an explanation
of the way a concept of the world comes about. This is an extremely
subtle point.
plain_english_below: The world arises in the six sense-bases. It is at the same time the arising of suffering... The law of dependent arising is an explanation of the way a concept of the world comes about. This is an extremely subtle point.
tts_line: The world arises in the six sense-bases. It is at the same time the arising of suffering... The law of dependent arising is an explanation of the way a concept of the world comes about. This is an extremely subtle point.

nanananda_verbatim:
The deepest point of the entire formula of paticca samuppada is
traceable to the interrelation that obtains between name and form on
the one hand, and between name-and-form and consciousness on the other.
plain_english_below: The deepest point of the entire formula of paticca samuppada (nothing happens on its own) is traceable to the interrelation that obtains between name and form on the one hand, and between name-and-form and consciousness on the other.
tts_line: The deepest point of the entire formula of paticca samuppada — nothing happens on its own — is traceable to the interrelation that obtains between name and form on the one hand, and between name-and-form and consciousness on the other.

nanananda_verbatim:
Like an expert physician, who treats the germ of a disease and
immunizes the patient, the Buddha effected a breach in the saṃsāric
vortex by concentrating on its epicycle within this fathom-long body.
plain_english_below: Like an expert physician, who treats the germ of a disease and immunizes the patient, the Buddha effected a breach in the samsaric vortex by concentrating on its epicycle within this fathom-long body.
tts_line: Like an expert physician, who treats the germ of a disease and immunizes the patient, the Buddha effected a breach in the samsaric vortex by concentrating on its epicycle within this fathom-long body.

nanananda_verbatim:
All the twelve links are dependently arisen, and avijjā is no
exception. Even ignorance arises with the arising of influxes,
āsavasamudayā avijjāsamudayo. So even ignorance is not the cause. The
cause is the underlying principle itself.
plain_english_below: All the twelve links are dependently arisen, and avijja (not seeing how it works) is no exception. Even not seeing how it works arises with the arising of influxes, asavasamudaya avijjasamudayo. So even not seeing how it works is not the cause. The cause is the underlying principle itself.
tts_line: All the twelve links are dependently arisen, and avijja — not seeing how it works — is no exception. Even not seeing how it works arises with the arising of influxes, asavasamudaya avijjasamudayo. So even not seeing how it works is not the cause. The cause is the underlying principle itself.

nanananda_verbatim:
What is called the cessation of consciousness has a deeper sense here.
It means the cessation of the specifically prepared consciousness,
abhisaikhata vinnana. An arahant's experience of the cessation of
consciousness is at the same time the experience of the cessation of
name-and-form.
plain_english_below: What is called the stopping of consciousness has a deeper sense here. It means the stopping of the specifically prepared consciousness, abhisaikhata vinnana (just knowing, before words). An arahant's experience of the stopping of consciousness is at the same time the experience of the stopping of name-and-form.
tts_line: What is called the stopping of consciousness has a deeper sense here. It means the stopping of the specifically prepared consciousness, abhisaikhata vinnana — just knowing, before words. An arahant's experience of the stopping of consciousness is at the same time the experience of the stopping of name-and-form.

nanananda_verbatim:
True to the qualities of the Dhamma — to be seen here and now, not
involving time, and inviting to come and see — the entire mass of samsaric
suffering ceases immediately.
plain_english_below: True to the qualities of the Dhamma — to be seen here and now, not involving time, and inviting to come and see — the entire mass of samsaric suffering ceases immediately.
tts_line: True to the qualities of the Dhamma — to be seen here and now, not involving time, and inviting to come and see — the entire mass of samsaric suffering ceases immediately.

nanananda_verbatim:
In order to ascertain whether a banana trunk is pith-less, it is not
necessary to go on removing its bark, layer after layer, from top to
bottom. We only have to take a sharp sword and cut the trunk in the
middle, so that the cross-section will reveal to us its pith-less nature.
Similarly, if we cut in the middle the banana trunk of preparations with
the sharp sword of wisdom, its internal structure as revealed by the
cross-section will convince us of the essence-less nature of the group
of preparations.
plain_english_below: In order to ascertain whether a banana trunk is pith-less, it is not necessary to go on removing its bark, layer after layer, from top to bottom. We only have to take a sharp sword and cut the trunk in the middle, so that the cross-section will reveal to us its pith-less nature. Similarly, if we cut in the middle the banana trunk of things the mind makes with the sharp sword of wisdom, its internal structure as revealed by the cross-section will convince us of the essence-less nature of the group of things the mind makes.
tts_line: In order to ascertain whether a banana trunk is pith-less, it is not necessary to go on removing its bark, layer after layer, from top to bottom. We only have to take a sharp sword and cut the trunk in the middle, so that the cross-section will reveal to us its pith-less nature. Similarly, if we cut in the middle the banana trunk of things the mind makes with the sharp sword of wisdom, its internal structure as revealed by the cross-section will convince us of the essence-less nature of the group of things the mind makes.

nanananda_verbatim:
According to the accepted interpretation, presented by the venerable
author of the Visuddhimagga, the first two links of the formula belong to
the past, and the last two links belong to the future. The remaining
eight links in the middle are taken to represent the present. That means,
we have here the three periods of time. So it is not — timeless.
plain_english_below: According to the accepted interpretation, presented by the venerable author of the Visuddhimagga, the first two links of the formula belong to the past, and the last two links belong to the future. The remaining eight links in the middle are taken to represent the present. That means, we have here the three periods of time. So it is not — timeless.
tts_line: According to the accepted interpretation, presented by the venerable author of the Visuddhimagga, the first two links of the formula belong to the past, and the last two links belong to the future. The remaining eight links in the middle are taken to represent the present. That means, we have here the three periods of time. So it is not — timeless.

nanananda_verbatim:
To the one attached, there is wavering. To the
unattached one, there is no wavering. When there is no wavering, there
is calm. When there is calm, there is no inclination. When there is no
inclination, there is no coming and going. When there is no coming and
going, there is no death and birth. When there is no death and birth,
there is neither a 'here' nor a 'there' nor a 'between the two'. This
itself is the end of suffering.
plain_english_below: To the one attached, there is wavering. To the unattached one, there is no wavering. When there is no wavering, there is calm. When there is calm, there is no inclination. When there is no inclination, there is no coming and going. When there is no coming and going, there is no death and birth. When there is no death and birth, there is neither a 'here' nor a 'there' nor a 'between the two'. This itself is the end of suffering.
tts_line: To the one attached, there is wavering. To the unattached one, there is no wavering. When there is no wavering, there is calm. When there is calm, there is no inclination. When there is no inclination, there is no coming and going. When there is no coming and going, there is no death and birth. When there is no death and birth, there is neither a 'here' nor a 'there' nor a 'between the two'. This itself is the end of suffering.

nanananda_verbatim:
When a dog, while crossing a stream, stops halfway on the plank and
starts wagging its tail and peeping curiously down, the reason is the
sight of its own image in the water. It imagines a dog there, a
'water-dog'. The dog thinks that there is something worthwhile seeing,
apart from the seen. It is unaware of the fact that it is seeing what
it sees because it is looking. It thinks that it is looking because
there is something out there to be seen. The moment it realizes that
it is seeing because it is looking, it will stop looking at its own
image in the water.
plain_english_below: When a dog, while crossing a stream, stops halfway on the plank and starts wagging its tail and peeping curiously down, the reason is the sight of its own image in the water. It imagines a dog there, a 'water-dog'. The dog thinks that there is something worthwhile seeing, apart from the seen. It is unaware of the fact that it is seeing what it sees because it is looking. It thinks that it is looking because there is something out there to be seen. The moment it realizes that it is seeing because it is looking, it will stop looking at its own image in the water.
